sentences.en: A group of foreigners arrived in Edo, i.e. Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 一群外国人抵达了江户，即现在的东京。

sentences.en: The volunteer group provides war victims with food and medicine.
sentences.zh: 志愿者团队为战争受害者提供食物和药品。

sentences.en: The activities of the volunteer group covered half a century.
sentences.zh: 志愿者团队的活动持续了半个世纪。

senses.zh: 组，群，团体，类小型流行音乐演奏组
